verses.en: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.sm: Isaraelu O le avega a Aikupito. Faauta, e tietie atu le ALII i le ao tele vave, e auo atu o ia i Aikupito; e gatete foi tupua a Aikupito i ona luma, e faavaivai ai foi loto o Aikupito i totonu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.sm: Ou te avatua foi auupega ia Aikupito e tau ai Aikupito; latou te tau o le tagata ma lona uso, O le tagata ma lé la te tuaoi, O le tasi aai ma le isi aai, o le tasi itu malo ma le isi itu malo.

verses.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.sm: E mavae atu foi le atamai o Aikupito nai totonu ia te i latou, ou te faaumatia foi lana pule; ona latou saili ai lea i tupua, ma e ua leo colo, ma aitu vavalo, ma e ua memu.

verses.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu Aikukupito; i le lima o le alii saua, e pule foi le tupu malosi ia te i latou, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii, o le ALII o ‘au.

verses.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.sm: E pe foi le suavai nai le vai e mate foi ma matutu le vaitafe.

verses.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.sm: E elo foi vaitafe, e maui ma mamate lava vaita‘i o Aikupito, e mamae le u ma le ‘utu‘utu.

verses.en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.sm: O le laolao e lata ane i le vaitafe, o i auvai lava, atoa ma mea uma ua totoina i le vaitafe, e magumagu ia, e faataapeapeina, e le toe i ai lava.

verses.en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.sm: E feoi o e fai faiva, e faanoanoa o i latou uma o e sausau i le matau i le vaitafe, e faavaivai foi i latou o e lafo upega ile fogávai.

verses.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.sm: E masiasi e ua fai lino lelei, atoa ma i latou o e lalaga lino sisina.

verses.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.sm: E lepetia ona faavae, O tagata uma foi o e galulue i se taui e tiga O latou loto.

verses.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.sm: E matua valelea lava alii sili o Soana, ua faavalea le pule a le au faipule popoto a Farao; pe faapefea ea ona outou fai atu ia Farao, O aʻu o le atalii o tagata popoto, O le atalii o tupu mai anamuá?

verses.en: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.sm: O ifea lava ou tagata popoto? se‘i latou faaali atu ia te oe, ma ia latou iloa, pe se a le pule a le ALII o ‘au ia Aikupito.

verses.en: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.sm: Ua faavalea alii sili o Soana, ua pelogia alii sili o Nafi, ua faaseseina foi Aikupito e alii o ona itu aiga.

verses.en: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.sm: Ua liligi atu e le ALII i totonu ia te ia, le agaga e faapiopio ai, o lea ua latou faaseseina ai Aikupito i ana mea uma e fai, e faapei ona tautevateva o le tagata ona i lona puaiga.

verses.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.sm: E lei i ai foi ia Aikupito se mea e fai, se mea lava e fai e le ulu po o le fu, e le lau pama po o le fiso.

verses.en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.sm: O lea aso e tusa ai Aikupito ma fafine; e gatete ma fefefe i latou ona o le aao O le ALII o ‘au ua siitia, ua siitia e ia i luga ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.sm: E avea foi le nuu o Iuta ma mea e mataʻu ai Aikupito; o i latou uma o e ta‘uta‘u atu lea nuu ia te i latou latou te fefefe ai, ona o le pule a le ALII o “au ua ia pule i ai.

verses.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.sm: O lea aso e tautala ai nuu e lima i le laueleele o Aikupito i le gagana a Kanana, latou te tauto foi i le ALII o ‘au; e ta‘ua le tasi, O ic aai o le malaia.

verses.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
verses.sm: O lea aso e i ai le fata faitaulaga i le ALII i totor:1 o le nuu o Aikupito, ma le faailoga i le ALII i tafatafa o lona tuaoi.

verses.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.sm: E fai ai foi ma faailoga ma molimau i le ALII o ‘au i le nuu o Aikupito; aua latou te alalaga i le ALII ona o e faasaua, ona auina atu ai lea e ia ia te i latou o le faaola, o le ua sili, na te laveaiina i latou.

verses.en: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
verses.sm: E faailoaina le ALII i Aikupito, e iloa foi le ALII e Aikupito i lea aso; latou te auauna ia te ia i taulaga ma mea alofa; latou te tauto foi i le ALII, ma latou faataunuuina.

verses.en: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.sm: E taia foi Aikupito e le ALII, na te taia, ma toe fofoina; ona latou liliu ai lea i le ALII, ona faafofoga lea o ia ia te i latou, ma fofo ia te i latou.

verses.en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.sm: O lea aso e fai ai le ala tele, e fua mai i Aikupito e oo i Asuria, e o atu Asuria i Aikupito, e o mai foi Aikupito i Asuria; e auauna foi Aikupito faatasi ma Asuria.

verses.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.sm: O lea aso e fai ai Isaraelu ma tolu o nuu, e faatasi ma Aikupito ma Asuria, e fai ma mea e manuia ai i totonu o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.sm: E faamanuia le ALII o ‘au ia te i latou, E faapea mai, Ia manuia loʻu nuu o Aikupito, ma Asuria le galuega a oʻu lima, atoa ma loʻu tofi o
